nodes.subject: exact-model Sony WH-1000XM3 owner discussion
nodes.object: three-year commuting use, continued usability, connection and isolated hardware issues, residual train noise, and home-trial preference without a controlled prevalence or comparison estimate

support_spans.exact_quote: So 3 years ago I bought ANC Bose QC 35 ii and Sony WH-1000XM3 at the same time and use them interchangeably for sleeping and for commuting.

accepted_phrases: An exact-model owner reports about three years of interchangeable Sony WH-1000XM3 and Bose QC35 II sleeping and commuting use and says both held up pretty well, while the thread also reports connection trouble, isolated cracking or rumble or headband events, residual train noise, and the need to try a headphone at home. These are scoped anecdotes, not prevalence or a controlled comparison.

nodes.subject: noise-cancelling headphone mechanism
nodes.object: active lower-frequency cancellation from higher-frequency reliance on isolation or more difficult cancellation

support_spans.exact_quote: Noise-cancelling headphones are headphones that suppress unwanted ambient sounds using active noise control (ANC).
To cancel the lower- frequency portions of the noise, noise-cancelling headphones use active noise control.

Higher-frequency sound has a shorter wavelength , and cancelling this sound would require locating devices to detect and counteract it closer to the listener's eardrum than is currently technically feasible or would require digital algorithms that would complicate the headphone's electronics.

accepted_phrases: Noise-cancelling headphones use active noise control for unwanted ambient sound; the mechanism source specifically discusses active cancellation of lower-frequency portions and the greater difficulty of cancelling higher-frequency sound. It does not measure any shortlisted model or prove speech elimination.

nodes.subject: sound masking in offices
nodes.object: the impression of intruding sound, distraction, and speech-privacy problems by adding sound

support_spans.exact_quote: A sound masking system can be used to reduce the impression of intruding sound (reducing annoyance, distraction) and improve acoustic privacy (including speech privacy).
Open offices can benefit from sound masking because the added sound covers existing sounds in the area â making workers less distracted and more productive.

accepted_phrases: Sound masking adds sound to reduce the impression or distraction of intruding sound and can be used in open offices. It is distinct from headset ANC and does not establish that any shortlisted headphone removes nearby speech.

nodes.subject: aptX and aptX Low Latency
nodes.object: implementation in both transmitter and receiver and audio-video synchronization for Low Latency

support_spans.exact_quote: The technology must be incorporated in both transmitter and receiver to derive the sonic benefits of aptX audio coding over the default sub-band coding ( SBC ) mandated by the Bluetooth standard.

aptX LL or aptX Low Latency is intended for video and gaming applications requiring comfortable audio-video synchronization whenever the stereo audio is transmitted over short-range radio to the listener(s) using the Bluetooth A2DP audio profile standard.

accepted_phrases: AptX benefits require implementation in both transmitter and receiver, and aptX Low Latency targets audio-video synchronization for video and gaming. These facts do not establish ANC strength, office speech reduction, comfort, or an audible advantage on an unspecified phone.

nodes.subject: SBC codec
nodes.object: an A2DP Bluetooth audio codec whose implementation remains mandatory for devices supporting the profile while vendors may add codecs

support_spans.exact_quote: SBC , or low-complexity subband codec , is an audio subband codec specified by the Bluetooth Special Interest Group (SIG) for the Advanced Audio Distribution Profile (A2DP).

As of A2DP version 1.3, the Low Complexity Subband Coding remains the default codec and its implementation is mandatory for devices supporting that profile, but vendors are free to add their own codecs to match their needs.

accepted_phrases: SBC is specified for Bluetooth A2DP and remains the default mandatory codec for devices supporting that profile, while vendors can add codecs. This establishes a compatibility baseline, not a product-quality or ANC ranking.

nodes.subject: Bluetooth profile capabilities
nodes.object: which desired Bluetooth services and audio streaming functions a device can use

support_spans.exact_quote: In order to use Bluetooth , a device must be compatible with the subset of Bluetooth profiles (often called services or functions) necessary to use the desired services.
The way a device uses Bluetooth depends on its profile capabilities.

Advanced Audio Distribution Profile (A2DP) This profile defines how multimedia audio can be streamed from one device to another over a Bluetooth connection (it is also called Bluetooth Audio Streaming).

accepted_phrases: A Bluetooth device must support the necessary profile subset, and its use depends on profile capabilities; A2DP defines multimedia audio streaming. Exact source-device and headphone capabilities must therefore be verified rather than inferred from a logo.
